content: On the Hour, Level One (jurists and traditionists) hold that every atom of a body dispersed in death will be reassembled and reinvested with life at that Hour; one may not ask how, and one must simply accept what the prophets and perfected men communicated.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
